guesses.reason: Small, fine-boned frame, large upright triangular ears, rounded head, and big dark eyes are classic Chihuahua traits.
The predominantly white coat with black-and-tan tricolor head markings, a white blaze, and a slightly wiry texture point to terrier ancestry.
The tricolor pattern with tan eyebrow and cheek points, the black body patch, and the lean, leggy build are typical of Rat Terriers.

breed.appearance: A small, slender dog with a mostly white, slightly scruffy medium-short coat. Its head is black with tan eyebrow dots and tan cheeks, split by a narrow white blaze that runs from forehead to muzzle, and it has a large black saddle patch on its left side. It has very large, erect, triangular ears that are tan inside with dark edges, big round dark-brown eyes, a short pointed muzzle with a black nose, and light freckling on its legs and paws. Its tail is curled upward with a black-and-tan tip, and it wears a teal collar with a silver bone-shaped tag.
breed.fun_fact: Chihuahuas may be tiny, but they have huge personalities and often form fiercely loyal bonds with their favorite people!
